title: NIST WebBook: Dioxosilane is O2Si, molecular weight 60.0843 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Dioxosilane as O2Si, molecular weight 60.0843 amu, CAS 7631-86-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Dioxosilane, CAS Registry Number 7631-86-9, lists molecular formula O2Si and molecular weight 60.0843 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 59.9667557716 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/O2Si/c1-3-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
